exposure: Presence or absence of prior vaginal birth
outcome: Composite neonatal adverse outcome (Apgar score <5 at 5 min, assisted ventilation >6 h, neonatal seizures, or neonatal death within 27 days)
cohort: Term, cephalic, singleton pregnancies with two prior cesarean births from the U.S. National Vital Statistics 2014-2018 period linked birth and infant death data
finding: Trial of labor after cesarean was associated with increased neonatal adverse outcomes compared to prelabor repeat cesarean birth, regardless of prior vaginal birth history.
mod_finding: The study investigated the outcomes of trial of labor after two cesarean births, comparing those with and without a prior vaginal birth.
